# Hash-pinned Playwright for the browser gate (tests/test_web_key_storage_browser.py).
# Used by the `web-browser` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml; the four required pytest
# jobs do not install it, so there the browser test skips.
# Regenerate (pin and hashes together, never by hand):
#   printf 'playwright==<version>\n' > web-browser.in
#   uv pip compile web-browser.in --generate-hashes --universal --python-version 3.9 \
#     --no-header --no-annotate -o requirements-web-browser.txt
